info.title: Consumable Type Extractor
info.description: Reads lab documents, extracts Consumable Type records, supports their review, and writes the DFD loader with an audit workbook. Every error has the shape `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`.

AcceptWarningChange.description: Accept a warning issue; individual-review warnings need the source viewed.

Alternative.description: One of the different values given for a conflicting field, with its evidence.

BulkActionSummary.description:
One bulk action of a run: what it changed, who made it and whether it was undone.

`field` is set for value changes; `issue_code` for accepted warnings. `record_count` counts
the records it touched. `can_undo` is true while it is not undone and the run is in review.

BulkPreview.description: The selection (mode, issue, code, field, its current value) and every matching record.

BulkPreviewMatch.description:
One record a bulk action would touch, with its matching issue and current value.

`alternative_index` (resolve conflicts only) is the chosen value's index in this record's
own alternatives list.

CellAlternative.description: One alternative of a conflicting field, as written, with its sources.

CellSource.description: One evidence pair of a value: its location and the quote.

ChunkSource.description:
A chunk's text for "Show source", with its document, section and page.

A scanned page has no text (`kind` is `page_image`).

ConfigVersions.description: The version of each config file; prompts are versioned one by one.

DataVersionInfo.description:
One admin upload of lookup lists or reference data as the API shows it (no storage path).

`file_name` is the name the file was uploaded with; `summary` holds the check report or
diff counts.

DataVersionList.description: Version history of lookup lists or reference data, and the version new runs use.

DuplicateCandidate.description:
One existing type a duplicate issue names in `details.candidates` (CONTRACTS §5).

`match`: `exact`, `normalized`, or the judge's verdict (`same`, `unsure`). Description, class
and active flag are copied from the run's pinned reference data, or None when it has none.

ErrorBody.description: What went wrong: a stable code, a plain message that says what to do, and details.

ErrorResponse.description: Every error response has this shape.

Evidence.description: One place a value was found: the chunk and the exact sentence or table row.

ExcludeRecordChange.description: Leave a record out of the export; a reason is required.

Exclusion.description: Who excluded a record, when, and why.

ExtractedField.description: One field of one record as the LLM returned it.

FieldOutput.description: Field-level output: the loader value (always text or empty), its origin and clean-ups.

FieldVerification.description: Field-level verification: the code citation check and the agent's verdict, if any.

HealthResponse.description: Liveness answer, with the config versions in use (or why no config is loaded).

Issue.description:
One issue; run-level issues have no record and no field.

`individual_review` and `note_required` are the catalogue's flags for the issue's code.

IssueSummary.description:
An issue as the grid shows it (open or accepted).

`note_required`: accepting it needs a note (catalogue). `sources`: the chunks the issue's
finding cites (e.g. missed candidates, challenged excluded items), only chunks of the run.
`duplicate_candidates`: the existing types a duplicate issue names (`details.candidates`).

LookupUploadReport.description: The check report of one upload: passed checks, problems, warnings and changes.

LookupUploadResponse.description: A lookup list upload's check report, and its pending version when it has no problems.

PickAlternativeChange.description: Choose one of a conflicting field's alternatives by its index.

RecheckResult.description: What a re-check did: changes applied, updated counts, judge calls made.

RecordDetail.description: One record with all its sections, its issues (any status) and its resolved sources.

RecordExtraction.description: Record-level extraction section, wrapped by code from the extraction response.

RecordFinding.description: A problem with a whole record.

RecordVerification.description: Record-level verification section: record findings and whether it was re-extracted.

ReferenceUploadReport.description: The check report of one upload: rows read, passed checks, problems and warnings.

ReferenceUploadResponse.description: A reference data upload's check report, and its pending version when it has no problems.

ReviewCell.description: One field of one record in the grid.

ReviewCounts.description:
Summary strip counts; issue counts leave out excluded records.

Progress: `total_issues` counts red and yellow issues (any status) of included records and
the run; `resolved_issues` counts those that are resolved or accepted.

ReviewRow.description: One record: action needed, name, where it was found, record issues and its cells.

ReviewView.description: The whole review grid: rows, run-level issues and counts.

RunDetail.description:
One run: status, current step, verified label, versions, documents, exports, run issues.

`current_step` is the processing status while the graph works, else null.

RunDocument.description: One uploaded document of a run (never its contents).

RunExport.description:
One export of a run as the API shows it: file names only, never storage paths.

The files download through the export's `loader` and `audit` endpoints.

RunField.description:
One loader field of a run's captured config, for the review screen's inputs.

`allowed_values` comes from the run's own lookup list version for a list field, is the
accepted values for a boolean field, and is empty for any other field. `is_record_name`
marks the one field that names a record.

RunFieldList.description: Every loader field of a run, in loader order, with the versions they come from.

RunSummary.description:
One run in the runs list: name, status, counts, the verified label and export state.

`failure_reason` is the message of a failed run's first error run issue, else null.
`latest_export` is the run's newest export, or null before the first one.

SaveResult.description: Which changes were stored as pending, and which were ignored as already stored.

SetValueChange.description: Set a field's output value; null clears it.

SheetChange.description: Values added and removed on one sheet, compared with the current version.

SourceLocation.description: Where a chunk is: document, section, page or sheet rows (resolved by code).

StartRunResponse.description: A run that was stored and queued for processing; follow it with `GET /runs/{run_id}`.

StoredField.description: One field of a stored record; `extraction` and `verification` are null if not extracted.

StoredRecord.description: A stored record with its sections and one entry per loader field.

UploadFinding.description: One check finding: where it is (sheet, row) and a plain explanation of what to do.

UploadLimits.description: The upload limits a new run is checked against; null means no limit.

VerifyResult.description: Verify's answer: verified, or the issues that block it; and warnings it accepted.
